title: Brilliant Scarf
description: The [blue]5th[/blue] card you play from your hand each turn is free.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks cards played from hand each turn. Resets at the start of each side turn. The 5th card played from your hand becomes free to play (costs 0 energy/stars). Only counts manually played cards; excludes auto-plays and cards played by other sources.
